fills.note: Beasty p2 49:38: after the tier-2 upgrade (-20% cost) it is 480 food with two charges. Tier 3 gives another -20% and +20% HP to non-naval mustered units. Three Loch Lookout gives +75% warriors per muster (p2 78:55).
fills.verdictReason: At 30:03-30:15, Master Pikemen: 'recruit 8 pikemen... for 600 food. It's an instant reinforcement. You get only one ticket for now.' That is 1 muster charge. At 36:18 he says 'I spent one ticket.'
